name: Nymph
description: Medium fey with 6 RHD. Enchantingly beautiful woodland spirit with DR 10/cold iron, blinding beauty, unearthly grace, and 7th-level druid spellcasting. LA +7.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A nymph can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination.

ability.name: Blinding Beauty (Su)
ability.description: Affects all humanoids within 30 feet of the nymph. Those who look directly at her must succeed on a DC 17 Fortitude save or be blinded permanently as though by the blindness spell. A nymph can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ability.name: Stunning Glance (Su)
ability.description: As a standard action, a wrathful nymph can stun a creature within 30 feet with a look. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Fortitude save or be stunned for 2d4 rounds. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ability.name: Unearthly Grace (Su)
ability.description: A nymph adds her Charisma modifier as a bonus on all her saving throws, and as a deflection bonus to her Armor Class.

ability.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
ability.description: This power works like the druid's wild empathy class feature, except that a nymph has a +6 racial bonus on the check.

ability.name: Spells (Druid)
ability.description: A nymph casts divine spells as a 7th-level druid (typical spells prepared 6/5/4/3/1, save DC 13 + spell level).
